# NexVora MV Studio
> NexVora MV Studio is an open-source (AGPL-3.0-only), local-first web application for creating animated lyric videos. Audio, lyrics and projects stay in the browser. No account or API key is required.

NexVora MV Studio is a modified version of UseSuno MV Studio (https://github.com/UseSuno/UseSunoMVStudio), developed by Prince AR Abdur Rahman and published by NexVora Lab's Ofc.

- Main application: /
- Lyrics timing editor: /timestamp.html
- Privacy policy: /privacy.html
- Open-source licenses: /licenses.html
- Corresponding source of this build: /source/verse-studio-source.zip
